questions.question_text: Case 1: A melon is cut into 8 equal pieces. Mina eats 6 pieces. What fraction did she eat?
questions.question_text_en: Case 1: A melon is cut into 8 equal pieces. Mina eats 6 pieces. What fraction did she eat?
questions.explanation: She ate 6 of 8 equal pieces, so the fraction is 6/8.
questions.explanation_en: She ate 6 of 8 equal pieces, so the fraction is 6/8.
questions.hint_th: ดูจำนวนชิ้นที่กินเทียบกับทั้งหมด
